title: perf(canary): auto-detect performance regressions and add rollout guards
author: Ethan Kim
description:
Motivation: Canaries are critical for catching regressions in latency and throughput during rollouts. Currently perf canaries require manual threshold tuning and trigger noisy alerts. This PR implements an automated detection pipeline that continuously evaluates canary telemetry, applies statistical tests to detect regression signals, and ties detection to automatic rollout guards in the deployment controller.

What this PR does: 1) Adds a statistical detector that applies robust, sample-aware tests (Cohen's d + bootstrap CI for latency distributions and negative-binomial Poisson tests for throughput) to identify regressions with configurable sensitivity. 2) Integrates the detector into perf-canary service; detections produce structured events consumed by rollout guard engine. 3) Implements rollout guard policies that can pause/incrementally rollback canaries when a regression is detected, with per-model cooldowns, required confirmation windows, and automatic re-evaluation. 4) Exposes new config surface in the Console to set model-specific thresholds and guard behavior. 5) Adds unit and integration tests, demo data for eval-harness, and documentation.

Design notes: - Detector runs on sliding windows (default 5m, configurable) and computes baseline using historical stable traffic. - To reduce false positives we use both magnitude (effect size) and significance (bootstrap CI) checks, plus optional smoothing and outlier trimming. - Rollout guard supports actions: pause, step-down weight, rollback to pinned model, and create incident for oncall. - All configs are feature-flagged under perf_canary.auto_detection for gradual rollout.

Rollout plan: feature-flag on in staging -> observe for 48h -> gradual enable on 10% of rollouts -> 50% -> 100% if stable. Emergency off via perf_canary.disable flag.

Checklist: - [x] Detector implementation (perf-canary/service/detector.py) - [x] Rollout guard engine (perf-canary/controller/rollout_guard.go) - [x] Console UI config (redwood-console/src/components/canary/CanaryConfig.tsx) - [x] CI workflow updates (ci/workflows/perf-canary.yml) - [x] Tests and eval-harness scenarios - [x] Docs (docs/perf-canary.md)

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the default sensitivity conservative to avoid noisy halts; ops can tighten thresholds per model. See linked Linear ticket ENG-5934 for detection parameter tuning history.
